name: Tengai ni Mau, Iki na Hana
source:
The game is set in the city of Akasaka where a small restaurant that has been established since the Meiji-era is still running. Unfortunately, the second-generation owner of the establishment no longer has the capacity to run the business effectively because of his severe illness. Due to this condition, he passes down the ownership to his son named, Kousuke Yajima.

However, Kousuke’s dream job is somehow different to his father. Since then, Kousuke has dreamed of having his own hotel in the future. And, a light of hope has shone upon him when his father handed down to him the ownership of their restaurant. For him, as long as the sign is intact, it is all good and this will serve as the starting point of his dream. But, his father Kouta, is strongly against his plan. Kouta wants him to continue and pursue their legacy in that restaurant for a lifetime.

On the other hand, the main protagonist of the game is a very responsible, and family oriented young girl named, Ritsu Azumi. Her family owns a Japanese Inn business located in the countryside along the coast. Their business is known for its traditional food and Azumi is in so much favor to inherit their business someday. However, her family simply just laugh about it, saying there is no way a girl would have the full capacity to manage it.

Then, one day, the protagonist’s fiancé, Kousuke Yajima, sent Ritsu a marriage proposal. Their fathers are old colleagues, and everyone in their respective families is extremely happy about this arrangement, except… Ritsu. However, their engagement serves as the starting line for the huge changes in Ritsu’s future…

Source: Play-asia
translation:
故事發生在赤坂。一家自明治時代便開業的小餐館仍在營業。遺憾的是，第二代店主身患重病，已經無力再經營下去。於是，他把店交給兒子弥島幸介。

然而，幸介夢想的職業與父親想要的截然不同。他一直夢想將來擁有自己的飯店。父親把餐館交給他後，希望之光終於出現。對他而言，只要招牌還在，一切就沒問題，這將成為夢想的起點。但父親幸太強烈反對他的計畫。幸太希望他一生繼續經營餐館，傳承家業。

另一方面，遊戲的主角安住律是一名責任心強、重視家庭的年輕女孩。她的家人在濱海小鎮經營日式旅館，旅館以傳統料理聞名，律非常希望有一天繼承家業。然而，家人只是笑著說，女孩子哪有辦法獨當一面，打理整間旅館。

一天，律接到了一門婚事，對象正是弥島幸介。他們的父親是老同事，兩家人都為這樁婚事感到高興，除了……律。這門婚事卻將徹底改變律的人生……

來源：Play-Asia
